description:
**CVRP partial reoptimization of geographically related route pairs.** Use a symmetric distance matrix and hard capacity. Begin with savings and visit an anchor route from the current list.

Choose one partner by minimum intercustomer distance to the anchor. Hold all other routes fixed and reoptimize the selected subset with savings, relocate and 2-opt*. Replace only the selected subset when its own total cost falls.

The two routes' customer set defines the boundary of a local subproblem. This is a small POPMUSIC-style partial optimization variant with a heuristic subproblem solver and bounded rounds.
